newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 76 bln pounds.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Lebanon issues CDs worth 76 bln pounds.

text.p: The Bank of Lebanon issued on Thursday certificates of deposit dated April 25 to commercial banks worth 76 billion Lebanese pounds.
The bank sold 60-day certificates worth 63 billion Lebanese pounds at 12.75 percent annual interest and 45-day CDs worth 13 billion pounds at 12 percent.

Last week the bank issued CDs worth 48 billion pounds, selling 60-day CDs worth 46 billion pounds and 45-day CDs worth two billion pounds at annual interest of 12.75 percent and 12 percent respectively.
